article.headline: Aleksander Pachucki scores 16 to help Bucknell fend off Akron 53-49
article.description: — Aleksander Pachucki's 16 points helped Bucknell defeat Akron 53-49 on Tuesday.
article.linkText: Aleksander Pachucki scores 16 to help Bucknell fend off Akron 53-49
article.story: LEWISBURG, Pa. -- — Aleksander Pachucki's 16 points helped Bucknell defeat Akron 53-49 on Tuesday. Pachucki shot 6 for 12, including 4 for 8 from beyond the arc for the Bison (1-4). Jayden Williams added 11 points and five assists. Evan Mahaffey led the way for the Zips (3-1) with 13 points, eight rebounds and three blocks. Tahj Staveskie added 10 points. Bucknell went into the half leading Akron 33-18. Pachucki scored 12 points in the half. Up next for Bucknell is a Saturday matchup with Siena at home, and Akron hosts West Virginia Tech on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
